title: Version 2.5.1 Update
whats_new: Enjoy the new header design featuring extension branding and a dropdown menu for easier navigation.
You can now manually scan websites whenever you want, with media detection limited to the currently active tab.
You can also enable automatic removal of detected media when its source tab is closed, keeping your media list clean.
The bottom action bar now adapts to available options, making it easier to access features, including the new Quick Add URL button.
The extension is now available in Spanish (es), making it accessible to more users.
Your download notifications are now more flexible. Minimize them, drag them anywhere and they'll remember their last position.
You can now receive download notifications and automatic updates without waiting for a new release on the AMO website. Automatic updates may take up to 24 hours to become available.
You can now view, pause, resume and cancel download progress in group mode without opening the group media list.
